_comment: India's national emergency short codes. Every number here is a published, nationally routed code that reaches a real control room; none is invented for the prototype. Manipur has no separate published tourist helpline, so the Ministry of Tourism's national line is listed instead of a made-up state number. Short codes are reachable from any handset, including one with no SIM or no balance.

name: Emergency response (any emergency)
description: One number for police, ambulance and fire across India. Use this first if you are not sure who you need, or cannot speak the local language.

name: Ambulance
description: Free emergency ambulance. Give the district and the nearest landmark; road names are often not enough outside Imphal.

name: Police
description: Police control room. 112 reaches the same responders and is the number the state now promotes.

name: Fire and rescue
description: Fire services, including rescue from water and road accidents.

name: Tourist helpline (Ministry of Tourism)
description: 24x7 national tourist helpline for lost documents, guidance and complaints. Also reachable on 1800-11-1363. Not an emergency line: call 112 if someone is in danger.

name: Women's helpline
description: Help for a woman in distress, including harassment and assault.

name: Childline
description: Help for a child in danger or in need of care.

name: District disaster control room
description: District emergency operations centre: flooding, landslides and blocked roads. The state control room is 1070.
